_comment: Surround locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, best to worst); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Giocador intorna a 'n {width}x{height} grid.
Seet el giocador {player_id}. Moviment valid: '[up]' '[down]' '[left]' '[right]' o w/s/a/d.
Obietiv: sopraviv a tucc i alter. I trai a hinn letai; i impatt cont i mur a hinn mortai; i scontr a testa de duu a hinn mortai tutt duu.

game_action.invalid_death: El giugador {player_id} l'è mòrt per un mòviment minga vàlid.

outcome.survived_win: El giugador {player_id} l'è sopravissüü; tücc i alter i è 'ndacc.
outcome.all_crashed: Tüt i giugador hinn cressüü insemma.
outcome.outlived: El giugador l'ha vivüü de tutt i alter.
outcome.turn_limit: L'è rivà el limit de gir: chi che l'ha restaa püsee a longh vinc.
